limitations: This is a three-seed C4, 5000-particle, 128-box, white-noise-1 campaign with a five-iteration cap; it does not replace a converged 100k/256 K=4 completion run or real-data validation.
RECOVAR did not converge before the cap and final-all-data reconstruction was not forced; final_class maps are exact copies of the last numbered half-map averages.
RELION Class3D emits full class maps rather than independent half maps, so half-map FSC and masked half-map resolution are outside this campaign's scope.

The checked per-class 0.143 GT resolutions come from the independently sealed rigid-alignment endpoint evaluator; the frozen trajectory gate uses the unmodified shellwise FSC audit and retains its own GT FSC-AUC values.
Peak HBM is a lower bound sampled every five seconds from engine-specific nvidia-smi monitors, not an allocator-exact maximum.

The top-level summary dependency job 13301426 remains pending because unrelated selected cases failed; the sealed summary files were generated directly from the retained summary launcher after all case jobs reached terminal state.
The post-hoc trajectory audits ran on CPU jobs 13303682-13303687 with the audit script from the original clean c75cbfffc source checkout; their resource/accounting snapshot is retained and hashed.
The run predates the later fixed-state hardening integrated at 22efd8065; this record is evidence only for source commit c75cbfffc.
